stories.title: He died in a sweltering house. Why doesn't his death record show it?
stories.summary: When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.

stories.title: Two dead after Monday attack on Saudi oil tanker in Hormuz, says shipping firm
stories.summary: Two dead after Monday attack on Saudi oil tanker in Hormuz, says shipping firm Two Filipino sailors were killed in an attack on an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, Saudi Arabia's national shipping company Bahri said on Wednesday. "Bahri confirms that its vessel SIDR was involved in a security incident while transiting the Strait of Hormuz" on the evening of August 31, the carrier said on X, confirming "the loss of its two Filipino seafarers as a result" of the attack. Reporting by AFP
stories.headline: Two dead after Monday attack on Saudi oil tanker in Hormuz, says shipping firm

"Bahri confirms that its vessel SIDR was involved in a security incident while transiting the Strait of Hormuz" on the evening of August 31, the carrier said on X, confirming "the loss of its two Filipino seafarers as a result" of the attack.

stories.title: US universities curb international student internships following federal warning
stories.summary: International students in the United States are facing new hurdles when it comes to internships and off-campus work after several major universities paused or restricted certain forms of Curricular Practical Training (CPT). CPT is a form of work authorisation that allows foreign students to take part in internships and other practical training related to their studies. The changes follow two August directives from the Student and Exchange Visitor Programme (SEVP), a division of US Immigration...
